parts-policy__short: Parts at cost with zero markup: you pay exactly what I pay.
parts-policy__long: I guarantee zero markup on parts. You pay exactly what I pay, and I shop around to source them as cost-effectively as possible. Prefer a specific brand, OEM parts, or the budget option? Just tell me and I'll adjust.
parts-estimate__unavailable: Parts will be quoted after I look up your VIN.
parts-estimate__service-basis: Typically {amount} · based on {count} price for {basis} | Typically {amount} · based on {count} prices for {basis}
parts-estimate__disclaimer: Ranges come from real parts-store prices I've collected for similar vehicles. Not a quote: I'll confirm the exact parts and prices before ordering. Parts bought locally on short notice usually cost more.
parts-estimate__disclaimer--with-type: Ranges come from real parts-store prices I've collected for similar vehicles ({type}). Not a quote: I'll confirm the exact parts and prices before ordering. Parts bought locally on short notice usually cost more.
auth-login__intro: See your vehicles, repair history and invoices.
auth-login__intro--claim: Sign in to save your request to your garage.
auth-register__intro: Keep every car's repair history and invoices in one place, and track your requests.
claim-page__pending: Adding this request to your garage…
claim-page__error-body: It may have already been used. If you saved this request before, it's in your garage.
garage-overview__intro: Every car's service history in one place.
garage-overview__unread: You have {count} new reply. | You have {count} new replies.
garage-overview__load-error: Your garage couldn't be loaded. Please refresh to try again.
garage-empty__body: Book a service while signed in and your car shows up here with its repair history. Booked before you had an account? Use the link in your confirmation email to add it.
garage-request__messages-intro: Ask anything about this job. I'll get an email and reply here.
garage-request__messages-placeholder: e.g. Could we move it to the afternoon? Is synthetic oil OK?
garage-request__appointment-requested: Requested around {date}. I'll confirm a time with you.
garage-request__labor-note: Labor only; parts quoted separately at cost, zero markup.
page-meta__description--home: Mobile mechanic: flat, upfront labor prices for brakes, suspension, tune-ups and more, done at your place. Zero markup on parts.
page-meta__description--book: Get an instant labor estimate and book a mobile mechanic. Enter your VIN and pick the work you need.
landing-hero__title: Honest mobile auto repair, done in your driveway.
landing-hero__intro: Brakes, suspension, tune-ups and more with upfront, flat labor prices. No shop markup, no waiting room.
landing-hero__highlight-body--parts: You pay exactly what I pay for parts, nothing more.
landing-hero__highlight-body--flat: Every job is priced by the time it really takes.
landing-hero__highlight-body--bundles: Shared teardown time is discounted, oil changes are free on big jobs, and long jobs drop to a lower hourly rate.
landing-hero__highlight-body--lead-time: Time to order the right parts at the right price.
landing-steps__step-title--1: Send your VIN and the work
landing-steps__step-body--1: Pick from the menu below and see your labor estimate right away. Your VIN lets me order exactly the right parts.
landing-steps__step-title--2: I order parts ahead, at cost
landing-steps__step-body--2: Jobs are booked about two weeks out so I can find the best price on your parts. You pay exactly what I pay, with zero markup.
landing-steps__step-body--3: Home, work, or wherever the car is parked safely. You get the job done without a trip to the shop.
landing-pricing__intro: Prices are labor only. Parts are quoted separately once I look up your VIN, and billed at cost with zero markup.
landing-pricing__service-call: Each visit includes a {fee} service call fee that covers travel.
landing-pricing__load-error: Prices couldn't be loaded right now. You can still
landing-policies__card-body--lead-time: Most appointments are booked about two weeks out so I can order parts for your exact vehicle.
landing-policies__card-body--emergency: Need it sooner? Jobs within {days} days are possible when the schedule allows, with a {fee} emergency fee.
landing-policies__card-body--short-notic: When there isn't time to order ahead, parts usually have to come from a local store at retail prices, which are likely to be higher.
landing-cta__body: Get your estimate in about two minutes.
intake-header__intro--booking: Tell me about your vehicle and the work you need. Your estimate updates as you go.
intake-header__intro--callback: Not sure what you need? Leave a note and I'll call, text or email you back.
intake-vehicle__vin-status--unknown: Couldn't look that VIN up automatically. Double-check it, or fill in the details below.
intake-vehicle__vin-hint: Find it on the driver-side dashboard (through the windshield), the door jamb sticker, or your registration/insurance card.
intake-vehicle__type-hint: Helps me show a parts price range before you submit. I'll confirm the real one from your VIN.
intake-services__intro: Labor prices shown. Brake and suspension work on the same axle is bundled for less.
intake-services__load-error: The service list couldn't be loaded.
intake-services__other-label: Describe the work or the problem
intake-services__other-placeholder: e.g. check engine light, squeal when turning, replace a window regulator…
intake-services__other-note: Some jobs need a lift or shop equipment and may not be something I can do on-site. I'll let you know either way.
intake-services__hint--free-addon: (optional) free when bundled with other work being performed
intake-date__intro: Appointments are usually booked about {days} days out so I can order parts. I'll confirm the exact time with you.
intake-date__warning-body--emergency: Jobs within {days} days add a {fee} emergency fee and depend on availability. Parts will likely have to be bought locally, which is usually more expensive.
intake-date__warning-body--short-notice: There may not be time to order parts ahead, so they may have to come from a local store at a higher price.
intake-contact__notes-placeholder--booki: Front or rear axle, symptoms, parts preferences (brand, OEM, budget), parking/access notes, best time to call…
intake-contact__notes-placeholder--callb: Describe what's going on with the car and the best way and time to reach you.
intake-estimate__empty: Pick a service to see your price.
intake-estimate__labor-hours: About {hours} hr of labor. Parts not included.
intake-estimate__error: The estimate couldn't be calculated right now. You can still submit.
intake-estimate__note--quoted-after-vin: Quoted after I look up your VIN.
intake-estimate__note--pick-vehicle-type: Pick your vehicle type above for a parts estimate too.
intake-estimate__note--preferences: Want a specific brand, OEM, or the budget option? Say so in your notes.
intake-estimate__note--short-notice: Parts bought locally on short notice are likely to cost more than ordered parts.
intake-estimate__note--other: "Other" work is quoted after I review it and may not be something I can cover.
intake-estimate__callback-body: Leave a note and I'll get back to you, usually within a business day. Prefer to talk now?
intake-estimate__no-payment: No payment now. I'll confirm the final price before any work starts.
intake-confirmation__body--booking: I'll look up parts for your vehicle and reach out to confirm a time along with a parts quote.
intake-confirmation__body--booking-date: I'll look up parts for your vehicle and reach out to confirm a time around {date} along with a parts quote.
intake-confirmation__body--callback: I'll get back to you as soon as I can.
intake-confirmation__labor-note: Plus parts at cost, zero markup. Final price confirmed before any work starts.
intake-confirmation__claim-body: Create a free account to track this request, see your invoice, and keep a repair history for your car. The link is also in your confirmation email.
intake-errors__vin--required: A VIN is needed so I can order the right parts.
intake-errors__vin--invalid: A VIN is 17 letters and numbers (never I, O or Q).
intake-errors__other--required: Tell me a bit about the other work.
intake-errors__notes--required: Leave a short note about what you need.
intake-errors__rate-limited: Too many requests from this connection. Please call or text {phone}.
intake-errors__generic: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again or call {phone}.
garage-dialog__title: Your garage needs a free account
garage-dialog__body: My garage keeps everything about your car in one place, so you never have to dig through emails.
garage-dialog__perk--1: Every car you've booked, with its repair history
garage-dialog__perk--2: Invoices with the real parts cost
garage-dialog__sign-in: I have an account, sign in
garage-dialog__note: You don't need an account to book. You can add a past booking to your garage with the link in its confirmation email.
settings-page__profile-hint: Need to change your name or email? Call or text me and I'll update it.
settings-page__language-hint: Used for this site on this device. Emails follow the language you booked in.
settings-page__logout-hint: Signed in on a shared computer? Log out when you're done.
intake-draft__restored: Picked up where you left off.
intake-consent__contact: I agree to be contacted by call, text or email about this request. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out of texts.
intake-consent__marketing: Optional: send me occasional deals and maintenance reminders by text or email.
intake-consent__marketing-promise: I promise not to spam you, and this isn't automated. It's just me.
intake-errors__phone--required: Leave a phone number so I can reach you.
intake-errors__consent--required: Please check the box so I can contact you about this request.
